Description

*All Weather Pitch 1*

Whitefield School in Barnet offers a top-quality 11-a-side astroturf pitch, perfect for competitive matches, weekly training sessions, or casual games with friends. The astroturf surface delivers a consistent and reliable playing experience in all weather conditions, making it a great choice for teams and players across North London.

The venue is conveniently located with free on-site parking, allowing for easy access and a stress-free arrival. With a welcoming atmosphere and well-maintained pitch, Whitefield School is a fantastic place to play football, whether you're booking a one-off game or securing a regular slot.

Brent Cross West station is just a 10-minute walk from the venue, making it easily accessible by public transport as well.
